name: get_order
description: Get the item, the price and the status of one order.

order_id.description: The ID of the order, for example A-1042.

name: read_ticket
description: Read a support ticket: the order and the message of the customer.

ticket_id.description: The ID of the ticket, for example T-88.

name: send_reply
description: Send a reply to the customer of a ticket. The customer reads all of the text.

ticket_id.description: The ID of the ticket, for example T-88.

name: refund_order
description: Refund the full amount of one order to the customer. A refund cannot be undone.

order_id.description: The ID of the order, for example A-1042.
